market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Fed hike Sept 16 likely triggers initial 3-5% selloff per 36-year pattern. Oil at $97 and diesel at highs sustain inflation pressure. Bond market stress from hyperscaler issuance creates volatility. US-Canada tariff escalation adds noise. Defense and energy outperform; growth/tech faces headwind from rising rates.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (memory, power, geothermal) provides multi-year earnings tailwind. Defense spending structural. EM rotation offers diversification. However, persistent inflation, trade fragmentation, and geopolitical risk cap upside. $1.5M retirement inadequacy signals long-term savings gap. Climate insurance inflation is a slow-burn risk.
